description: Get the current date/time, or convert a given timestamp, into a target IANA timezone with ISO, Unix and human-readable forms. Pass a Unix timestamp (seconds or ms) or an ISO string as input; omit it for "now". LLMs cannot know the real current time, so use this instead of guessing.

input.description: Optional: a Unix timestamp (s or ms) or ISO date string. Omit for the current time.

name: datetime

local.description: Human-readable local time in the timezone.

title: Current or parsed date/time
